name: Smalti
artist: GIMP team & GNOME Project, with Mosaic additions
description: Mosaic's default tool set, named for the coloured glass a mosaic is set from. Built on the GIMP color tool icons by the GIMP team (with roots in GNOME's art-libre set — icons by Jakub Steiner, Andreas Nilsson, Klaus Staedtler and others), CC-BY-SA 4.0. Mosaic additions and modifications: Hand and Move adapted from Kaiz Khatri's apple_cursor set (GPL-3.0); Inpaint and Red Eye reworked in-project; Blur, Dodge and Burn carry distinguishing badges; the Polygonal and Magnetic Lassos are derived from GIMP's free-select icon; the Edge Select Brush adds a lightning badge to the selection-brush art; the eleven shape-tool icons are Mosaic originals (CC0). Full per-icon provenance in docs/credits.md.
license: CC-BY-SA-4.0 (GIMP icons) / GPL-3.0 (hand, move) / CC0-1.0 (shape tools)
